component.name: Lectrix
component.summary: View, annotate and combine PDF files

description.p: Lectrix is a lightweight PDF editor. What it writes (annotations, bookmarks and page labels) opens correctly in Acrobat and in every other mainstream PDF reader.

ul.li: Read with continuous scrolling, thumbnails, text search and tabs
Highlight, underline, strike out, add notes, draw and type on the page
Number pages as the book does: roman front matter, then arabic
Combine several PDF files into one, page by page
Repair annotations from other apps so they display everywhere
